summary: Two male climbers ages 22 and 20 from Boulder became stuck on the top pitch of the T-2 climb on Tower Two of Redgarden Wall in Eldorado Canyon State Park after a slower-than-expected ascent left them without headlamps at dark; RMRG ascended the East Slabs, climbed to the top of Tower Two and rappelled down to them, then assisted both up and back down the east slabs on multiple rappels; both walked out uninjured (second reached the parking lot at 6:45 a.m. Sunday 3/10) in an ~11-hour operation.
location: T-2 climb, Tower Two, Redgarden Wall, Eldorado Canyon State Park
responding_agency: Boulder County Sheriff's Office; Rocky Mountain Rescue Group
notes: BCSO release case 24-01250 (govdelivery bulletin); Mountain View Fire Protection District initially toned.
